data.description:
## Description

**What**: Author tests/audits/A0-stack-consumer-inventory.md enumerating every legacy singular-equality stack pattern in plugins/ and .claude/ before any migration commit.
**Why**: Inventory is the migration checklist; sprint stories are sized one-per-consumer; dso:completion-verifier confirms 100% checked before A0 closes.
**Scope**:
- IN: Audit script that grep/sg-scans for legacy patterns (e.g., `[[ "$stack" == "..." ]]`, `case $stack in`, `if [ "$stack" = "..." ]`); inventory markdown listing file:line for every hit; commit BEFORE any migration commit.
- OUT: Performing the migrations (separate stories); pre-commit hook (separate story).

## Done Definitions
- When complete, tests/audits/A0-stack-consumer-inventory.md exists with file:line entries for every legacy stack-pattern in plugins/ and .claude/ ← Satisfies: "Pre-migration inventory enumerates every legacy-pattern hit before migration commits"
- When complete, an audit script (referenced in the inventory) reproduces the same hits when re-run ← Satisfies: "post-migration the same audit script returns zero legacy-pattern matches"
- When complete, unit tests written and passing for the audit script

## Considerations
- [Maintainability] Inventory format must be machine-parseable so completion-verifier can confirm 100% checked
- [Testing] Audit script must distinguish real refs from comments — prefer ast-grep (sg) over plain grep where feasible

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a maintainer, I have a pre-migration inventory of every legacy stack-pattern hit
